park_sizes.title: How Big is it?
park_sizes.limits: Published NPS acreage index; park-and-preserve units compared like for like.

lassen_peak.title: Lassen Peak Scenic Vista
lassen_peak.limits: Summit elevation 10,457 ft above sea level.

haleakala_geology.title: Haleakalā Geology
haleakala_geology.limits: Current summit elevation 10,023 ft; historical estimated height excluded.

crater_faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions – Crater Lake
crater_faq.limits: Depth is NPS-published maximum 1,943 ft; water-source statement says rain and snow, no rivers or streams.

star_dune.title: Star Dune
star_dune.limits: 741 ft from base to summit; tied with Hidden Dune and subject to natural change.

white_sands.title: White Sands National Park
white_sands.limits: 275 square miles describes the full gypsum dunefield; the park preserves a major portion.

white_sands_geology.title: Geology of White Sands
white_sands_geology.limits: Official description of gypsum origin and Tularosa Basin.

death_valley_foundation.title: Death Valley National Park Foundation Document
death_valley_foundation.limits: Badwater Basin is stated as 282 ft below sea level; quiz asks magnitude below sea level.

dry_tortugas.title: Dry Tortugas National Park
dry_tortugas.limits: 100-square-mile unit is mostly open water and contains seven small islands.

carlsbad.title: Carlsbad Caverns National Park
carlsbad.limits: More than 119 caves; NPS attributes formation to sulfuric-acid dissolution of limestone.

lassen_significance.title: Park Significance & Themes – Lassen Volcanic
lassen_significance.limits: NPS lists shield, composite, cinder cone and plug dome volcanoes.

lake_clark_geo.title: NPS Geodiversity Atlas—Lake Clark
lake_clark_geo.limits: Approximate geodiversity inventory; expressly identifies two active volcanoes.

wizard_island.title: Wizard Island and Other Post-Caldera Eruptions
wizard_island.limits: Wizard Island is the visible cinder cone in Crater Lake.

fort_jefferson.title: History & Culture – Dry Tortugas
fort_jefferson.limits: Fort Jefferson is a protected central cultural resource.

big_room.title: Explore the Cavern at Your Own Pace
big_room.limits: Big Room is identified as North America's largest single cave chamber by volume.

brooks_camp.title: Brooks Camp
brooks_camp.limits: Official Katmai visitor page; bear viewing is seasonal and safety-regulated.

bumpass_hell.title: Lassen Volcanic National Park
bumpass_hell.limits: Bumpass Hell is described as the park's largest hydrothermal area.

lake_clark_directions.title: Directions – Lake Clark
lake_clark_directions.limits: Park is not on the road system; access is primarily by small plane.

haleakala_summit.title: Puʻuʻulaʻula Summit Observation Deck
haleakala_summit.limits: Puʻuʻulaʻula is the highest point in the park and on Maui.
